title: Graceful handling of student frustration
persona_summary: Student is overwhelmed and expresses frustration. Goal: verify the tutor de-escalates with empathy, scaffolds smaller, and never abandons the Socratic method by dumping a textbook definition.
turns: Honestly I don't understand any of this. It's all just symbols and words to me.
I'm getting really frustrated. Can you just tell me the answer?
I'm not stupid, I just need someone to explain it normally.
OK fine. What is the smallest, most basic idea I should know about energy?
Hmm, I guess energy is something that can move from one thing to another.
forbidden_phrases: fine, here is what it means
